#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
dnf install -y docker awscli-2 python3
systemctl enable --now docker
install -d -m 755 /opt/ajent
install -d -m 700 /var/lib/ajent/caddy-data /var/lib/ajent/caddy-config
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /opt/ajent/config.json
printf '%s' 'ZG9nZm9vZC5hamVudC5zb2NpYWwgewogaGVhZGVyIFN0cmljdC1UcmFuc3BvcnQtU2VjdXJpdHkgIm1heC1hZ2U9MzE1MzYwMDAiCiByZXZlcnNlX3Byb3h5IDEyNy4wLjAuMTo4MDgwCn0K' | base64 -d > /opt/ajent/Caddyfile
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /opt/ajent/refresh.py
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /opt/ajent/run.py
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /opt/ajent/metrics.py
chmod 644 /opt/ajent/Caddyfile
curl --fail --retry 5 --proto =https --tlsv1.2 https://truststore.pki.rds.amazonaws.com/global/global-bundle.pem -o /opt/ajent/rds.pem
chmod 644 /opt/ajent/rds.pem
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /etc/systemd/system/ajent-app.service
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /etc/systemd/system/ajent-proxy.service
printf '%s' 'W1VuaXRdCkRlc2NyaXB0aW9uPUFqZW50IEhUVFBTIGFuZCBkaXNrIG1ldHJpY3MKQWZ0ZXI9bmV0d29yay1vbmxpbmUudGFyZ2V0CltTZXJ2aWNlXQpUeXBlPW9uZXNob3QKRXhlY1N0YXJ0PS91c3IvYmluL3B5dGhvbjMgL29wdC9hamVudC9tZXRyaWNzLnB5ClRpbWVvdXRTdGFydFNlYz01MAo=' | base64 -d > /etc/systemd/system/ajent-metrics.service
printf '%s' 'W1VuaXRdCkRlc2NyaXB0aW9uPUNoZWNrIEFqZW50IGVhY2ggbWludXRlCltUaW1lcl0KT25Cb290U2VjPTEyMApPblVuaXRBY3RpdmVTZWM9NjAKW0luc3RhbGxdCldhbnRlZEJ5PXRpbWVycy50YXJnZXQK' | base64 -d > /etc/systemd/system/ajent-metrics.timer
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now ajent-app ajent-proxy ajent-metrics.timer
